test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The area of a square is 900 cm². Its perimeter is equal to the perimeter of a regular hexagon. What is the area (in cm2) of the hexagon?
solution:
Given:

A square and a regular hexagon have the same perimeter.

Formula used:

Area of square = (side)²

The perimeter of the square = 4 × side

Area of the hexagon = 6 × [√3/4] × a²

Calculation:

⇒ Side of the square = √900 = 30 cm

The perimeter of the square = 4 × side = 120

The perimeter of the hexagon = 6 × side

According to the question:

⇒ 6 × side = 120

Side = 20

 Area of the hexagon = 6 × [√3/4] × a² = 6 × [√3/4] × 20 × 20 = 600√3

The answer is **600√3**
